## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) commentary on the **Mahāsthāmaprāpta Universal-Penetration Chapter** (*Shìzhì yuántōng zhāng*) of the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Jiéliú Xíngcè** 截流行策 [行策](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A1%8C%E7%AD%96) (1628–1682), traditionally counted as the **tenth Patriarch of the Chinese Pure Land lineage**. Preserved as **X16 no. 312** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The work belongs to the cluster of late-Míng / early-Qīng *Mahāsthāmaprāpta-chapter* commentaries — including [KR6j0718](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0718) (Zhèngxiàng) and [KR6j0719](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0719) (Xùfǎ) — that extracted the chapter from its *Lèngyán* setting and presented it as the principal Mahāyāna scripture for **Chán–Pure Land syncretism**. Xíngcè's reading places the *niánfó* gateway alongside the *zhǐguān* 止觀 of [馬鳴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A6%AC%E9%B3%B4) Mǎmíng (Aśvaghoṣa) as one of the two *equal pillars* of Buddhist practice — a programmatic statement of his own institutional career, which led from intensive Línjì Chán practice through the Liánfū ān 蓮柎庵 founding (1663) to the Liánshè 蓮社 revival at Yùshān Pǔrén yuàn 虞山普仁院 (1670). Composition window: 1663 (his first major Pure Land establishment) – 1682 (his death).
